text:
I have seven lives, I have seven lives.

Seven lives of gold; lovely and florid.

Head cut off, head replaced:

My tree-spirit sprouts again in the siesta.


Purple dragon of flowering claws,

seven lives I have, I have seven lives.

Giants and dwarfs: cut off my heads,

they will grow stubborn as weeds.


I have seven lives, I have seven lives,

seven lives of gold lovely and florid

that irons tire and swords notch,

yet one day they will be forever felled.


The prince I await will dry

the seven flowering heads. Without

abracadabras,

the winged dragon will lose its lives

beneath the slender edge of

sweet words.

translation.title: Seven Lives
translation.editorial_note: The translation keeps the fairytale dragon refrain and the paradox of defeat by sweet words.
